turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What was the p99 latency on that service before you started?

turns.speaker: agent

turns.speaker: agent

turns.speaker: candidate

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What is the difference between optimistic and pessimistic locking?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Optimistic locking assumes conflicts are rare, so you let the write proceed and check a version number at commit time, and if it changed you retry. Pessimistic locking takes the lock up front and makes everyone else wait, which is safer under contention but costs you throughput and risks deadlocks.

turns.speaker: agent
